summary: Row of angled street bays in a shopping strip; no homes, but exposed.
reasons: Angled bays short for a van
Open to the street and shops

best_section.where: Angled bays on the north side of the shop block, by the Bank Road corner

drivers.seclusion: Shops and a church all round, nearest dwellings not mapped within 50 m. The bays face a street and a car park, so a van is plainly visible.
drivers.access_and_room: Open angled bays off the street; marked bays about car length, a 7 m van would overhang.
drivers.traffic: Town-centre street with a railway about 60 m east; quiet overnight but visible.
drivers.convention: Signed 1P and 4P angle parking in daytime hours; cars park here, overnight use not signed against.

flags: Daytime time limits on surrounding signs
Angled bays may not fit a long van
sun_shade: Open to sun; the building to the south shades the bays at midday.
